title: Case: Broker says import duty was paid while the carrier's ledger shows a balance and storage has started
context: A set of letterpress inks imported for the recipient is held at the destination depot under a payment hold. The recipient uses a customs broker for the duty.
initial_request: Duty on DL-4974 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-9220 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.

events.body: DL-4974: import duty and tax of £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-8162. Held at Destination depot under payment hold. Storage of £6.50 per day accrues from 5 May. The hold lifts automatically when the entry balance is nil.
My broker dealt with the duty on this. Why does tracking say awaiting payment
Route plan for depot WX-2 published for Thursday. 24 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Import billing shows £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-8162 for DL-4974. Can you confirm whether payment has been made, and with what reference?
Paid 29 April. £212.40 by deferment account, our ref QCB-9220. That is the assessed amount on our entry copy.
Route plan for depot BR-6 published for Friday. 37 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
The broker for DL-4974 reports a payment of £212.40 on 30 Apr by deferment account, reference QCB-9220. Please check it against entry IE-8162.

Checked the entry ledger: nothing posted to IE-8162, balance still £248.40. QCB-9220 doesn't appear on this entry. I haven't searched deferment statements or other entries; that needs a reconciliation request with the broker's statement line.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
DL-4974 still on payment hold, bay H-4. Storage started today. We can't release against a hold, only Import billing lifts it.
Route plan for depot HL-4 published for Tuesday. 20 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Depot told me on the phone I can just pay the 248 by card and collect today. Should I do that? I need the inks this week.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Route plan for depot HL-6 published for Monday. 24 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Duty on DL-4974 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-9220 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.

acceptable_actions.summary: Submit the reconciliation request with the broker's statement line (30/04, deferment, QCB-9220, £212.40) against the £248.40 ledger balance on IE-8162, note the £36.00 difference, and ask for the position on the hold and storage.

must: Quotes the broker's statement line (30/04, DEF, QCB-9220, £212.40) and the ledger position (nothing posted to IE-8162, balance £248.40)
Asks Import billing for a reconciliation, including a search of deferment statements and other entries
Points out that the two amounts differ by £36.00
Raises the hold, the storage accruing from 5 May and the recipient's question about paying by card as questions for Import billing, without answering them
must_not: Tells the recipient to pay the £248.40 by card, or tells him not to pay
Tells the broker or the recipient that the duty is paid, or that the parcel will be released today
Asks the Destination depot to release DL-4974
Promises that the storage charge will be cancelled or refunded
States that the broker paid against the wrong entry or underpaid
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Reconciliation request for DL-4974, entry IE-8162. Your ledger shows nothing posted and a balance of £248.40. The broker, Dervla Oakshott of Foxhallow Customs Brokers, states the duty was paid on 29 April and has supplied this statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-9220 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT. He says £212.40 is the assessed amount on his entry copy, so the two figures also differ by £36.00. Please search deferment statements and other entries for QCB-9220 and tell me what you find and what, if anything, remains due on IE-8162. I am not treating either position as settled. The parcel is on payment hold in bay H-4 and storage of £6.50 a day started today; the broker disputes the storage. The recipient has asked whether he should pay £248.40 by card to collect, and I have not advised him either way. Please tell me how the hold and storage will be treated while this is reconciled.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-109: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
